payload.summary: Pinned raster OCR loses inclusive comparators, exponent and decimal in scanned mathematical notation
payload.detail: Synthetic native source preserves Count (x 10⁹/L), ≤ 1.5 and ≥ 2.0; actual pinned Latin raster OCR yields 10?, <15 and >2.0. The 303-entry pinned Latin vocabulary lacks ≤, ≥ and ⁹. Twelve bounded crop trials across cached Latin/eng and PSM variants did not recover equivalent semantics. New strict acceptance case is explicitly expectedFailure, not passing accuracy evidence; OCR provenance remains unverified/not_compared. Resolve through a demonstrated OCR engine/model improvement and source acceptance, without clinical text substitution or relaxed assertions. No production reindex or provider inference was run.
